gloss: late start; falling behind; slow start

definitions.gloss: late start; falling behind; slow start
definitions.explanation: starting something later than others or later than optimal; being behind in timing compared to competitors or schedules

examples.japanese: ⟦スタート→スタート：11053_sutaato⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{出遅|でおく}れた。
examples.english: I got off to a slow start.

examples.japanese: IT⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出遅|でおく}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧。
examples.english: To make up for falling behind in digitalization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{出遅|でおく}れ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I feel like I got a late start on job hunting.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to leave/start) + ⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ (to be late) → late start
- {出遅|でおく}れる (to get a late start, to fall behind)

USAGE:
- Races and sports (slow start from the gate)
- Business (late entry into a market)
- Technology adoption (falling behind competitors)
- Job hunting (starting later than peers)
- Trends (being slow to catch on)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {出遅|でおく}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{戻|もど}す→取り戻す：04223_torimodosu⟧ (to make up for a late start)
- {出遅|でおく}れ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (sense of being behind)
- {出遅|でおく}れ⟦{気味|ぎみ}→気味：27635_gimi⟧ (somewhat behind)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出|で}し{抜|ぬ}く (to get ahead of others)
- ⟦{先行|せんこう}→先行：03773_senkou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to lead, be ahead)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れ：01908_okure⟧ (delay)
- {後|おく}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to fall behind)
- ⟦スタート→スタート：11053_sutaato⟧ダッシュ (quick start)
